sections.notes: Put-in Bradley A. Hammer Memorial Conservation Area: exact agency access pin. Take-out Hendrickson Boat Launch: approximate area only. Missouri law: no glass beverage containers on canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in a sealed non-glass cooler; carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat; children under 7 wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry (no agency mileage found).
